verdict.rationale: Customer.io explicitly claims 'Your AI can do anything you'd do by clicking or typing' (docs-1) and ships a Pipelines/Track API plus MCP server, but its own docs contradict full parity: broadcasts must be set up in the UI and only triggered via API (docs-4), and segments/journeys are shown as UI-defined constructs (docs-11, docs-12). Independent evidence reinforces this gap—a developer built an open-source alternative specifically due to 'lack of code-based flexibility for defining segments and email flows' (customer-io-comm-3). missing for 10: API-only creation of broadcasts/segments/email flows without prior UI setup, and independent confirmation that MCP/API coverage matches 100% of UI functionality.
